title: IDD Provider Health Verdict
description: Read-only, cross-pull-request health verdict for the advisory-review and ci-actions services, aggregated from already-observable per-PR evidence. Never a gate: no field here is, or is consumed as, a merge-readiness or CI-gate result.

protocolVersion.description: Fixed contract-version tag for this output shape.

now.description: ISO-8601 capture instant of this run.

advisory-review.description: Health verdict for the advisory-review service (e.g. Copilot review requests).

verdict.description: healthy: zero failure evidence in the sampling window. degraded: some failure evidence, but either below the corroboration threshold or offset by success evidence in the same window. unavailable: failure evidence corroborated across at least minCorroboratingPrs distinct pull requests, with zero success evidence in the window. unknown: the evidence snapshot was unreadable, internally contradictory, or empty -- the floor for every insufficient or ambiguous case, never unavailable.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason: evidence-unreadable, contradictory-evidence, no-evidence, all-healthy, failure-below-corroboration-threshold, mixed-evidence-with-corroboration, or full-failure-with-corroboration.

distinctFailingPrCount.description: Count of distinct pull-request identities contributing failure evidence to this service within the sampled window.

distinctSuccessPrCount.description: Count of distinct pull-request identities contributing success evidence to this service within the sampled window.

minCorroboratingPrs.description: The resolved providerHealth.minCorroboratingPrs threshold this verdict was evaluated against.

ci-actions.description: Health verdict for the ci-actions service (GitHub Actions workflow execution).
